en.headline: Man’s body recovered near Stonecutters Bridge, suspected drowning
en.dek: A man aged about 40 was found floating in the sea near Stonecutters Bridge early this morning; clothes recovered at a nearby private pier suggest he may have been swimming.
body: Police and firefighters recovered the body of a man aged about 40 from the sea near Stonecutters Bridge off Kwai Chung shortly after 8.24am on Thursday after a report of a floating object.

The man, about 1.7 metres tall and of heavy build, was certified dead at the Tsing Yi fireboat pier. No identity documents were found on him. Clothing was later located at a private pier on Cheung Fai Road, and initial inquiries indicated he may have drowned while swimming.
Police are investigating the man’s identity and the circumstances. Anyone with information is asked to contact Tsing Yi Division on 3661 2800.

zh.headline: 昂船洲大橋附近海面撈起男屍 疑游泳遇溺
zh.dek: 今早8時許有人發現昂船洲大橋附近海面有人形物體載浮載沉，救援人員撈起一名約40歲男子，初步相信游泳期間遇溺。
body: 警方及消防今早約8時24分接報，指葵涌貨櫃碼頭對開、昂船洲大橋附近海面有人形物體載浮載沉。救援人員到場撈起一名約40歲男子，身高約1.7米，身形肥胖，經檢驗後證實不治。
事主身上沒有身份證明文件。人員其後在長輝路一個私人碼頭發現其衣物，初步調查相信事主在游泳期間遇溺，死因有待驗屍確定。
警方正調查死者身份及事件詳情，呼籲知情人士致電3661 2800與青衣分區警署聯絡。
